matches.competition_reliability_reason: Current UEFA Champions League league-phase evidence and team news are source-backed; no prestige prior is used.
matches.operational_viability_reason: Current UEFA results, qualification state and pre-match team-news/predicted-lineup evidence are available before kickoff.
matches.h2h_basis: Historical UEFA H2H is not used as material predictive evidence; current 2026/27 Champions League form and current personnel carry the assessment.
matches.competition_format: 36-team league phase; each club plays eight matches. Positions 1-8 qualify directly for the round of 16, 9-24 enter the knockout play-offs, and 25-36 are eliminated.
matches.qualification_state: Real Madrid enter on a perfect nine points from three and top-eight pace. AEK have three points after one win and two losses, so AEK have the stronger recovery need while Madrid retain top-eight/seeding incentive and some draw utility.
matches.simultaneous_results_note: Matchday 4 is not the final simultaneous league-phase round.
matches.match_context_basis: Normal Champions League travel is present but no verified rest/fatigue asymmetry is large enough to alter the football grades.
matches.common_evidence_basis: AEK's UCL results are 1-0 LASK, 1-3 Shakhtar and 1-5 Manchester City. Real Madrid are 3-0-0 with 2-1 Inter, 4-3 Roma and 4-1 Leipzig. Current predicted XIs retain AEK's Jovic/Varga route and Madrid's Bellingham/Vinicius/Mbappe attacking core.
matches.main_failure: Real Madrid can dominate without an AEK reply, but their current European carrier has already scored four in consecutive matches and AEK have conceded eight across their last two UCL games.
matches.supported_line_basis: Madrid's current four-goal carrier evidence plus AEK's repeated scoring and heavy leakage support both G3 and a separate fourth-goal path; the compiler remains authoritative.
matches.carrier_self_fund_basis: Real Madrid scored four against Roma and four against Leipzig in consecutive Champions League matches, so the away carrier is independently capable of funding a high burden.
matches.independent_upper_tail_basis: All three Madrid UCL matches reached at least three goals and the last two reached five and seven; AEK's last two reached four and six. The fourth-goal path is supported by current same-competition evidence.
matches.upper_tail_transferability_basis: The upper-tail evidence comes directly from the current Champions League league phase for both teams.
matches.upper_tail_comparable_context_basis: Four of the teams' last five combined UCL matches reached at least four total goals.
matches.failure_attacks_route_basis: The main risk is a one-sided Madrid control win, not loss of the Madrid scoring route.
matches.material_suppression_basis: No current all-route suppression is verified.
matches.g3_current_structure_basis: Madrid provide a STRONG self-funding carrier and AEK have scored in every UCL match while conceding heavily against Shakhtar and Manchester City.
matches.activation_basis: AEK's last two UCL matches opened into multi-goal games and Madrid have scored four in consecutive league-phase fixtures with their main attacking core still projected to start.
matches.board_state_basis: Strong self-funding Madrid carrier, high AEK leakage and same-competition upper-tail evidence make this a high-quality goal candidate.

matches.competition_format: 36-team league phase; each club plays eight matches. Positions 1-8 qualify directly for the round of 16, 9-24 enter the knockout play-offs, and 25-36 are eliminated.
matches.qualification_state: Liverpool enter on a perfect nine points from three and top-eight pace. Fenerbahce have two points from three and are outside the stronger qualification positions, so Fener have much greater recovery pressure while Liverpool retain top-eight/seeding value.
matches.simultaneous_results_note: Matchday 4 is not the final simultaneous league-phase round.
matches.match_context_basis: Normal Champions League travel is present but no verified rest/fatigue asymmetry is large enough to alter the football grades.
matches.common_evidence_basis: Fenerbahce's UCL results are 1-1 Roma, 0-6 Aston Villa and 2-2 Slavia Praha. Liverpool are 3-0-0 with 2-1 Atletico, 6-3 LASK and 4-3 Villarreal. Liverpool travel without Ryan Gravenberch and several defenders/forwards, while Fener are also missing Asensio and Ake.
matches.main_failure: Liverpool's injury list can reduce control and Fener can still fail to score, but Liverpool have conceded in every UCL game while scoring at least two in all three.
matches.supported_line_basis: Liverpool's strong carrier, Fener's usable home reply and repeated same-competition high totals protect G3 and support a separate G4 path; the compiler remains authoritative.
matches.carrier_self_fund_basis: Liverpool scored six at LASK and four against Villarreal, establishing a current self-funding three-plus route.
matches.independent_upper_tail_basis: Liverpool's last two UCL games produced nine and seven goals; Fener's three UCL matches produced two, six and four. Same-competition evidence supports continued scoring through goal four.
matches.upper_tail_transferability_basis: The strongest high-total evidence is from the current Champions League league phase, not domestic mismatches.
matches.upper_tail_comparable_context_basis: Four of the six combined UCL matches have reached at least four goals, including Liverpool's last two and Fener's last two.
matches.failure_attacks_route_basis: The principal risk is Fener failing to contribute, but Liverpool's carrier remains strong enough that the route itself is not broken.
matches.material_suppression_basis: No verified all-route suppression exists; current injuries cap XI robustness at MEDIUM but do not erase either route.
matches.g3_current_structure_basis: Liverpool have scored 12 in three UCL matches and conceded in all three; Fener have scored in two of three and must chase points at home.
matches.activation_basis: Liverpool's last two Champions League games became extreme multi-goal contests, while Fener's last two produced six and four total goals and their table position gives them little reason to sit on a draw.
matches.board_state_basis: Strong Liverpool carrier, live Fener reply and high same-competition tail make this a high-quality goal candidate.
